abstract: This paper examines the stock market reaction to the recognition of enterprise data resources in the financial statements of Chinese A-share listed companies, following the Ministry of Finance’s mandate effective from 1 January 2024. By incorporating data resources as either intangible assets or inventories, firms introduce new valuation considerations, with investors increasingly viewing these resources as pivotal to corporate innovation and value creation. Our empirical findings reveal a significant positive market reaction to the recognition of data resources, reflecting heightened investor confidence in the potential value of these assets. Further cross-sectional analysis uncovers that non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs) and financially constrained firms experience a stronger market reaction, and firms with lower institutional ownership and higher R&D investments similarly exhibit more pronounced reactions. Moreover, our results show that firms recognizing data resources as intangible assets, rather than inventories, receive stronger positive responses, indicating that investors value long-term strategic commitment to data integration. Our findings hold important implications for corporate managers, investors, and regulators.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国A股上市公司在财务报表中确认企业数据资源所引发的股票市场反应，这一做法源于财政部自2024年1月1日起生效的规定。通过将数据资源确认为无形资产或存货，企业引入了新的估值考量，投资者日益将这些资源视为企业创新和价值创造的关键。我们的实证研究发现，数据资源的确认引发了显著的正向市场反应，反映出投资者对这些资产潜在价值的信心增强。进一步的横截面分析发现，非国有企业（非国企）和融资约束较强的企业经历了更强的市场反应，机构持股比例较低和研发投入较高的企业同样表现出更为显著的反应。此外，我们的结果表明，将数据资源确认为无形资产而非存货的企业获得了更强的正向反应，这表明投资者看重对数据整合的长期战略承诺。我们的发现对企业管理者、投资者和监管机构具有重要启示。

title: Market reaction to the recognition of data resources in financial statements
